title: Messages that carry files
spec: Request 15 PostFiles { room, text (may be empty), files (1 to 10 ids) } and push 68 Attached { room, cursor of the message, files (1 to MAX_ATTACHMENTS: id, name, size, image size) }, with exact bytes and limits. DurableServer::post_files attaches only the poster's own uploads in that room that are not attached yet, no file twice (BadAttachment, E_BAD_ATTACHMENT, otherwise), in one journal record (Op::PostFiles, tag 17); an empty text reads as the files' names. attachments(room, cursor) lists them; deleting the message detaches its files, which download then answers NotFound; a restart replays both. After a Sync, a message's Attached push follows its Posted push only on a connection whose handshake agreed to FEATURE_FILES (the session passes its features). The client's inbox keeps a message's files beside the timeline (RoomView::attachments) without moving its cursor.
